brief: 6 side-income streams a solo founder can ship in a weekend — real numbers.

slots.title: Sell a Notion Template
slots.body: Build a productivity dashboard in 6 hours. Price it at $19–$49 and list on Gumroad. One creator cleared $8K in a single month with zero ad spend.
slots.tipBody: Validate first: tweet the mockup and pre-sell five copies before you build.

slots.title: Ship a Micro-SaaS Tool
slots.body: Spin up a single-feature API wrapper with Next.js in one weekend. Charge $9 per month. A solo dev hit $2.3K MRR in 90 days solving one painful CSV task.
slots.tipBody: Use Stripe Checkout and Vercel to avoid devops entirely.

slots.title: Launch a Paid Newsletter
slots.body: Curate niche insights for founders and gate the deep dives. Substack makes billing trivial. Top solo writers earn $5K–$20K monthly inside six months.
slots.tipBody: Write three free posts first, then flip the paywall on the fourth.

slots.title: Drop a UI Icon Pack
slots.body: Design 60 icons in Figma, export as SVG and font. Sell on Creative Market for $29 per license. One designer netted $4K in the opening weekend.
slots.tipBody: Target a trending framework like Tailwind or Framer.

slots.title: Sell Weekend Audits
slots.body: Offer a 48-hour teardown of landing pages or onboarding flows. Price at $300–$500. Founders pay for speed and a fresh pair of eyes.
slots.tipBody: Record a Loom instead of a PDF to cut delivery time in half.

slots.title: Publish a Mini Ebook
slots.body: Compile your top 20 tweets into a tactical PDF using Canva. Sell it for $15. A founder shipped one in a day and made $1,200 the first week.
slots.tipBody: Add a Notion bonus to double perceived value instantly.

slots.body: Stop researching and start building. Reply with the number you are launching first.
